column1: # grpc-ref-catalog.tsv — the ONLY hand-written part of the gRPC reference.
# The roster is not here. It is the grpc.ServiceDesc registration tables in
# the servers actually hand to gRPC. Method names, streaming shape and message types are
# read from there; this file carries one sentence per method and nothing else.
# Both directions are enforced. A registered rpc with no row here is red, and a row here
# for an rpc no descriptor registers is red — the second is how a reference keeps
# advertising a call that was removed two releases ago.
#   full method  /<package>.<Service>/<Method>, exactly as it travels on the wire
#   summary      one sentence: what a caller gets, not a restatement of the name
